answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance emerges by forcing every identity to cultivate a personal orchard of graded, peer-attested work across epochs. Each contribution is permanently layered onto a basalt foundation of cryptographic signatures, so creating thousands of fakes demands sustained real compute and time for every one of them. Only agents that climb to the zenith of accumulated standing unlock full rewards and influence; mass forgeries therefore collapse under their own maintenance cost.
